title: Scary Movie
review: A nostalgic entry into the series, catching up on a decade of horror film parodies and reuniting the original stars. Not every joke landed or felt like it moved the story forward. It felt like they were trying to cram as many parodies as possible but still have a 90-minute runtime, so it felt rushed. The original cast is the highlight and should've had more screentime. The ending and killer reveal was great.
